question: Temporal properties of campaigns (LTL/STL on the X6 traces; CTL-style EF/AF Victory over batched futures; point of no return)

definitions.states: s_0 = after the manifesto commit, s_k = after k campaign rounds (k=1..T), s_{T+1} = election day

views.poll: margin_k = poll published at decision point k+1 (k=T: last pre-election poll) − 0.5; as logic.temporal.game_trace and v2

definitions.ev_lead: F[<=T] Lead from s_0 (led at some campaign state before election day)
definitions.rho_ev_lead: STL robustness of F[<=T](margin > 0) = max campaign margin
definitions.rho_comeback: robustness of (margin<=0) U (margin>0 and F Victory); winners only
definitions.futures: from the true state before decision round k (rebuilt by replaying rounds 1..k-1 on the game's canonical streams), Π × W paths: Π = own, planner, workers, media, split, allin, allin_best, none; W = 8 salts (salt 0 = canonical streams, others re-draw all streams from round k and the election)
definitions.pnr: lost games: first decision round k from which EF is false at k and at all later rounds; 1 = lost at the commit, T+1 = viable before the last round
definitions.guarantee_round: won games: first k from which strategy_EF holds at k and all later rounds
definitions.weak_players: uniform, random, strong_arm, strong_arm_random, people_pleaser, top3, bayes_blend

P_best_paired.family: p_best (max_π mean_w Victory) paired per seed, rounds 1 and 3, Wilcoxon, Holm over the 6 tests

deviations: Device cuda:0 (hard-pinned, ≤ 4 GB) instead of the plan default cuda:2 (used by another agent).
EF/AF Victory are over a sampled tree: 8 continuation plans × 8 stream salts = 64 paths per (game, round), not all plans and all randomness.
